Homemade Mayonnaise
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 1:00am

Ingredients




1 sm. egg
1 teaspoon sugar
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon mustard
4 teaspoons vinegar
Dash of Tabasco
Pepper or paprika
1 pt. or oil that has been chilled in refrigerator

Preparation

1 Beat the egg with the salt, sugar, mustard, and vinegar; add the oil slowly, drop by drop until half has been used. Add the paprika or the pepper and add the rest of the oil.
